🎬 Box Office
Critics and audiences grade films separately. A great audience grade (A/A+) gives a film real "legs" — it can hold steady or even grow in week two. A bad grade craters fast no matter how big the marketing spend.
🎯 Marketing
Marketing has diminishing returns past ~2.5x a film's budget. Past that point you're just burning money — better to spend it on theaters or a second film.
🌍 World Markets
Each market has a censorship rating and government type — high-censorship markets can block or cut your riskier films. Diversify your markets to smooth out box office swings.
🎭 Franchises
A franchise's brand strength is built from its last 3 installments. A string of weak sequels causes real "franchise fatigue" — quality still matters even with a built-in audience.
🏢 Departments
Building an in-house VFX, Sound, or Score department costs more upfront but is free per-film afterward — cheaper long-term than hiring outside vendors on every release. Department level caps rise as the eras progress.
📅 Run Length
Plan a longer theatrical run for films you believe in — you can always extend a hit, but a flop will still close early regardless of what you booked.
⭐ Actor Mode
Your Acting Archetype shapes how fast you build fame. Heartthrobs and Influencers build fame fastest; Method Actors grow slower but with a stronger skill foundation.
